SBI PO Prelims Cut Off 2026

The State Bank of India has released the Pre Cut off for the SBI PO Examination. The Phase I test evaluates candidates in Reasoning Ability, Quantitative Aptitude and English Language for 100 total marks. Aspirants have to achieve the aggregate qualifying score fixed by the bank to qualify. SBI does not enforce sectional minimum cut offs in Phase I relying solely on total marks. Candidates can access the scorecards through the SBI PO result link using the credentials. The result determines eligibility for Phase II.

Factors Affecting SBI PO Prelims Result 2026

The qualifying cut-off score for Phase I is calculated using multiple operational variables. Rather than remaining static the qualifying mark shifts each year based on exam conditions. Main factors influencing the SBI PO Prelims Result 2026 cut-off scores include

  • Total Vacancies: The 1,500 openings announced for 2026 directly regulate shortlisting ratios
  • Difficulty Level : Complex reasoning puzzles or data interpretation sets lower average scores & decrease cut-offs
  • Total Number of Test Takers: Higher student participation increases competition for shortlisted slots
  • Normalization Process : Multi-shift tests are adjusted using equipercentile normalization to balance shift difficulty

How to Check SBI PO Prelims Result 2026

You can now easily get the result online on the official website. Now by using the official SBI PO pre result link makes sure to get correct scorecard records. Just follow the below steps to download the SBI PO Prelims 2026 Result

  1. Go to the official website @sbi.bank.in
  2. Then click on “Current Openings” & select “Recruitment of Probationary Officers (CRPD/PO/2026-27)”
  3. Click on the SBI PO result link or scorecard download option properly
  4. Enter the Registration No. /Roll No. & Date of Birth of the candidate
  5. Submit the details to view, download & save the prelims scorecard

SBI PO Selection Stage 2026

Candidates qualifying in Phase I advance to the Phase II Mains Exam on 12th September 2026. Prelims exam marks are qualifying in nature & are not added to the final SBI PO merit list. The subsequent selection stages consist of below mentioned points.

  • Phase II Mains Exam : Objective test (200 marks) evaluating Reasoning, Data Analysis, General Awareness & English, plus a Descriptive test (50 marks)
  • Phase III Psychometric Test & Interview: Psychometric assessment followed by Group Exercises (20 marks) & Interview (30 marks)
  • Final Merit Selection : Final ranking calculated by combining Phase II & Phase III scores scaled out of 100.

SBI PO Prelims Result 2026 FAQs

Ques: When will the SBI PO Prelims Result 2026 be declared?

Answer: The SBI PO Prelims 2026 Result has been released on 28th August @sbi.bank.in

Ques: Is there a sectional cut-off in SBI PO Prelims 2026 ?

Answer: No the State Bank of India does not apply sectional minimum cut-offs in SBI PO Pre Result of Phase I. Shortlisting depends on aggregate marks

Ques: Where can the candidates access the SBI PO pre result link?

Answer: The direct SBI PO Prelims 2026 Result link is published under the Careers section @sbi.bank.in

Ques: What details are needed to check the SBI PO Pre Result 2026 ?

Answer: Candidates need the Registration No. or Roll No. along with the Date of Birth or Password to log in for SBI PO Prelims 2026 Result

Ques: Are prelims exam marks added to the final SBI PO merit list?

Answer: No Phase I marks are used for shortlisting candidates for the Mains exam & do not count toward final selection only
